rationale: The candidate reads coherently in all four views as one dominant carved mass with a clear primary rule, so it avoids the one-view-only failure. It responds reasonably to the parcel and keeps the dominant gesture inside the boundary, but the ground void is modest and somewhat recessed rather than strongly public. The blue access edge is acknowledged by an opening/void condition, though the response is not especially emphatic or porous. The silhouette is more boxy and stepped than sectionally rich; the roof/section does not yet fully convert the mass into a compelling long-span or terrace logic. Overall it is program-plausible for neighborhood living and mixed-use at this early stage, but still needs a cleaner public threshold and stronger section/void articulation.
